correctness.rationale: For the final all-parameter claim, walk moments are controlled by colour refinement; adjacency Kronecker-sum factorizes exponential walk series; the first-exit decomposition is valid through length at most the shorter path order because walks cannot exit both ends; cross logarithm contributions begin at degree m+1. Triangular leading coefficients recover short side-distance multiplicities. A complete multiset-pairing argument recovers the short coordinate, series division recovers the long coordinate, and the rooted-unfolding witnesses give both sharp lower bounds. Tested exact depth/orbits/moments on 539 grid parameters, total 147224 vertices. No asymptotic claim relies on the finite test alone.

value.rationale: The complete natural two-parameter family of planar rectangular Cartesian grids receives an exact depth formula, a sharp square/non-square phase transition, and the stable orbit partition/class count. These quantify the number of local refinement rounds needed to distinguish grid positions, a motivated graph isomorphism and finite-model-theory invariant. The upper bound is not supplied by the earlier corner-pair lower bound; the result is not a mere reparameterization or isolated small computation.
